# Margin call (`margin-call` v1)

A variation or initial margin call and its settlement status.

**Group:** Collateral and margin · **Mnemonic:** `MC` · **Identifiers:** `MC-…` in `callId`

Open one with `MC <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: margin-call
version: 1
description: A variation or initial margin call and its settlement status.
match: { kind: margin-call, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Collateral and margin · Margin call, id: $.callId }
strip:
  - { label: Date, bind: $.callDate, fmt: date }
  - { label: Type, bind: $.marginType }
  - { label: Direction, bind: $.direction }
  - { label: Amount, bind: $.amount, fmt: amount0, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Status, bind: $.status, tone: status }
  - { label: Dispute, bind: $.disputeAmount, fmt: amount0 }
panels:
  - id: events
    kind: ladder
    title: Workflow
    key: F2
    rows: $.events
    columns:
      - { label: Time, bind: "@.at" }
      - { label: Event, bind: "@.event" }
      - { label: By, bind: "@.by" }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.nettingSet, 'netting-set')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
